narr: An anomalously moist airmass ahead of a frontal boundary sparked numerous showers and thunderstorms across the District of Columbia. Instantaneous rain rates approached five to six inches an hour during the evening, but were transient. Storms still dropped a quick one to two inches in twenty minutes, resulting in flash flooding throughout the District.
ev: At least six inches of water flowing across Sherman Avenue NW in front of DCFD Engine Company 4 firehouse.
Vehicle stranded in bottom of Calvert Street NW at bottom of hill. 1.5 feet of water with stalled vehicle, no rescue.
